claim: When you register a new domain name with Route 53, Route 53 automatically creates a hosted zone that stores the DNS records for the domain.

evidence.quote: Route 53 automatically creates a hosted zone that stores DNS records for your domain.
Use the AWS Management Console or the API to register your new domain name.
When you register a domain with Route 53, the service automatically makes itself the DNS service for the domain. It does the following:
Creates a hosted zone that has the same name as your domain.
